envelope.description: Approval mapping test and compatibility tests

body.title: Approval mapping test and compatibility tests
body.summary: Update approval-class-mapping.test.ts with the PER_INPUT_OR_DESTRUCTIVE_SINCE_S5 set and the addedByS5 list without editing the 228-row snapshot, and add gh-compat.test.ts for ids, old inputs, result shapes and legacy failure text.
acceptanceChecks: the eight listed tools resolve to common or destructive, never none
the snapshot file is byte-identical and the 46 ids are all registered
old inputs run the same gh argv

tests.name: approval-class-mapping.test.ts: PER_INPUT_OR_DESTRUCTIVE_SINCE_S5 members resolve to common or destructive and never none, and the snapshot is not edited
gh-compat.test.ts: the 46 existing ids are registered, old inputs run the same argv, result data keeps its shape and legacy failure text stays in output and error
gh-typed-call.test.ts: the 46 existing tools called through typed callTool keep their concrete result types
